name: Shadowboxing
steps: Stand light on the balls of your feet in a balanced boxing stance with knees soft, chin tucked, and hands guarding your cheeks.
Move smoothly across the floor while throwing crisp alternating combinations of jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts into the air.
Pivot your feet and hips into each punch while weaving, slipping, and snapping your hands right back to guard.
Keep moving and breathing rhythmically in continuous flow for the target duration.
tips: Keep your punches controlled and avoid snapping your elbows into painful hyperextension when punching air.
Stay relaxed through your shoulders and exhale sharply on every punch.
